Station on a tall post at left with a solar panel and its reflection. Amber rings leave the antenna and run down a flooded bungalow street toward a small hub. Caption: Its radio signal can carry more than a half-mile in streets.
Rings fade. A dashed scale bar draws and a More than a half-mile amber tag pins near the hub at 29.4 s. The hub mast lamp lights at about 29.8 s. Same street caption.
Scale bar, tag and lit mast lamp held on the flooded street. Caption disappears at 30.8 s.
Street at 31.0 s. Cut at 31.2 s to green open country with chain link fence, a Hub building with mast and a Station inset at upper left. Caption: In open country, up to five miles, to a hub.
Rings from the inset grow across the sky. An Up to five miles in open country tag pins at 32.2 s. The mast lamp glows and the hub window lights by 32.6 s.
Concentric amber rings keep spreading over the open-country hub. Tag, mast lamp and lit window held. Fringing on rings not confirmed at this size.
Same open-country hub with rings and the five-mile tag held. Caption disappears at 34.8 s.

Open country held to 35.2 s. Cut at 35.4 s to the hub interior: a seated responder in a navy jacket at a desk with a Flood path map monitor. Disclosure: Illustration. Not a real hub. Caption: At the hub, a second, larger AI maps.
An A second, larger model tag pins above the monitor. Yellow station dots appear along the blue creek on the map. The responder's hands move on the keyboard.
Desk composition held with dots on the map and the model tag. Small hand movement at the keyboard. Same caption.
Desk at 38.0 s. Cut at 38.2 s to a full-frame Flood path map. Orange path spreads along the creek at 38.6 s and branches down streets at 38.8 s. Caption: flood paths for responders.
Orange flood paths complete. At 39.6 s a Higher risk legend and a For emergency responders tag pin, and dashed amber zone outlines draw around low streets.
Map held with three dashed higher-risk zones and the responders tag. Caption ends by 40.4 s, map holds without caption to 40.8 s.

Cut to a cork notice board on posts over a flooded lawn and street. A Validation accuracy card pins at 41.2 s with an empty bar and Reported by the university, plus an amber ring marker. Caption: The university reports early chip AI validation.
Orange fills the validation bar left to right behind the ring marker, reaching the end around 42.8 s. Same caption.
Bar full and the ring marker fades. A second blue pushpin appears at the card's right corner at 43.6 s. Board and flooded street held.
Card with full bar and two pins held on the board. The caption disappears at 44.6 s.

Slightly closer on the card. 98.82% fades in at 45.4 s and is fully legible from 45.6 s. Caption: Accuracy was ninety eight point eight two percent. An Initial assessments tag begins to appear at 45.8 s.
An Initial assessments after training tag swings in and pins under the validation card. Same caption.
At 47.4 s a blank Field result card slides in from the right, a yellow pushpin presses it home at 47.8 s.
Validation card, assessments tag and blank Field result card held on the board. Same caption to the end of the page.
Cut at 49.2 s to a standing figure in a green coat holding a rubber stamp in front of the board. Disclosure: Illustration. Not a real report or map. Caption: The announcement reports no field result.
The arm swings the stamp over the cards. At 50.6 s a None reported stamp mark appears on the Field result card, then the arm lifts.
The stamp arm moves back down to waist height. None reported stays on the card. The figure stands with both hands low.

At 52.2 s cut to the same figure beside a chain link fence with a pipe post, a city skyline and a pond behind. A paper grid map with a blue creek pins to the fence at 52.8 s. Caption: It names no town with an installed station.
The figure raises an arm and points across the paper map, the finger moving along the creek and then up over the grid.
The finger points on the map. At 54.4 s a dark Announcement names no installation tag pins at the top of the map. The arm returns to the side.

Fence and map held to 55.4 s. At 55.6 s cut to a wide yard: porch rail, flooded street, a small technician holding a sheet and a case, a dashed station outline, live oak and skyline. Caption: Deployment is still the goal.
The technician holds a Deployment plan sheet. An amber arc starts at 56.4 s and an amber ellipse rings the dashed station outline by 56.6 s. A Field result None reported tag pins.
A Deployment goal amber tag pins at 57.0 s. The caption is gone by 57.4 s. From 57.6 to 57.8 s the technician lowers the sheet to waist height.

Held: the technician about a fifth of frame height with the plan sheet tilted at the waist. Dashed outline ringed amber, Deployment goal and Field result tags at right. No caption. The sheet is not seen entering the case.
The tail composition holds at 59.0 and 59.2 s. At 59.4 s cut to a dim credits card fading in, bright by 59.6 s: Texas AI Docket wordmark, flag, URL, source and music credits.
Static credits card: The Daily Dispatch, Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, UT San Antonio Today September 8th, and the Sincerely music credit line.
The same static credits card continues unchanged with wordmark, flag, URL, sources and music credit legible.
The static credits card continues identically with wordmark, flag, URL, and source and music lines.
Static credits card unchanged across all five samples: wordmark, flag, URL and credit lines.
Static credits card held through the final frame at 64.367 s: same wordmark, flag, URL and credits.
